name: Busa Agent Shelf
description: Agent shelf desk for e-commerce sellers: track whether AI shopping agents (ChatGPT, Gemini, Meta Muse, Amazon Rufus, Perplexity) recommend your products for the questions buyers ask, who they pick instead and why, and a review queue of sourced listing fixes. The AirApp only records a person's decision on a fix; it never contacts a shopping agent or edits a store.

label.zh-CN: 跑一遍本周的智能体货架检查

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-agent-shelf` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run this week's check end to end: ask every tracking question in each agent from Settings, record the answers, update competitors, and propose listing fixes for the gaps.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先读这个文件夹里的 `busa-agent-shelf` 技能并按它的流程做，然后完整跑一遍本周检查：在设置里的每个智能体上问一遍所有追踪中的问题，记录回答，更新竞品，并为缺口提出修改。

label.en: Brief me on our agent shelf
label.zh-CN: 给我讲讲我们的智能体货架现状

body.en:
{target}

Read the `busa-agent-shelf` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then give me a short brief: share of shelf per agent versus the previous check, the high-priority questions we are missing from, and the fixes waiting for my decision.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

先读这个文件夹里的 `busa-agent-shelf` 技能并按它的流程做，然后给我一个简短汇报：各智能体的被推荐比例与上次相比的变化、我们缺席的高优先级问题、等我决定的修改。
